ctx.x: Price...Baby Loving (?)...he's still living--Baby Loving (?)...drummer... a helluva drummer.

Anyway, when I went to New York...well, when I left New York, went back to Kansas City...everybody said, "Oh, you couldn't make it... too rough for you." But I had told John Hammond that I was gettin' homesick. John Hammond used to give me five hundred dollars a week--work or no work--said, "Now, go out and have yourself a good time. Look around New York. You'll love it."
